# U.S. Department of State

> Official U.S. government site for U.S. foreign policy, diplomacy, travel, visas, passports, and international engagement.

The Department of State publishes policy statements, country information, travel advisories, visa and passport guidance, press materials, treaties, reports, and resources from U.S. embassies, consulates, and policy bureaus worldwide.

## Department Overview
- [Home](https://www.state.gov/): Main entry point for Department news, policy, services, and public resources.
- [About Us](https://www.state.gov/about-us/): Overview of the Department’s mission, leadership, organization, and history.
- [Bureaus and Offices](https://www.state.gov/bureaus-offices/): Directory of Department bureaus, offices, and functional responsibilities.
- [Biographies](https://www.state.gov/biographies/): Profiles of senior Department leaders, ambassadors, and officials.
- [Careers](https://careers.state.gov/): Foreign Service, Civil Service, internships, and fellowship opportunities.
- [Contact Us](https://www.state.gov/contact-us/): Public contact information and inquiry channels for Department offices.

## Policy Issues and Global Topics
- [Policy Issues](https://www.state.gov/policy-issues/): Hub for major foreign policy themes, regional priorities, and cross-cutting issues.
- [Countries & Areas](https://www.state.gov/countries-areas/): Country and regional pages with policy, travel, and bilateral information.
- [Office of the Spokesperson](https://www.state.gov/office-of-the-spokesperson/): Statements, briefings, remarks, and media resources from Department leadership.
- [Human Rights](https://www.state.gov/policy-issues/human-rights-and-democracy/): Resources on democracy, human rights, and related foreign policy priorities.
- [International Security](https://www.state.gov/policy-issues/international-security/): Arms control, nonproliferation, and broader security policy materials.
- [Economic Prosperity and Trade Policy](https://www.state.gov/policy-issues/economic-prosperity-and-trade-policy/): Economic statecraft, trade, sanctions, and commercial diplomacy resources.
- [Climate Crisis](https://www.state.gov/policy-issues/climate-crisis/): Climate diplomacy, energy transition, and environmental policy materials.

## Travel, Passports, and International Travel
- [Travel.State.Gov](https://travel.state.gov/): Primary portal for passports, international travel, visas, and U.S. citizen services.
- [U.S. Passports](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/passports.html): Passport application, renewal, status, and eligibility information.
- [International Travel](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/international-travel.html): Travel advisories, country information, and preparation guidance for travelers.
- [Travel Advisories](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/traveladvisories/traveladvisories.html): Current advisory levels and safety information by destination.
- [Country Information Pages](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/international-travel/International-Travel-Country-Information-Pages.html): Destination-specific entry, safety, health, and local law guidance.
- [U.S. Visas](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas.html): Visa categories, application steps, interview requirements, and policy updates.
- [International Parental Child Abduction](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/International-Parental-Child-Abduction.html): Prevention, legal process, and country-specific abduction resources.

## Visas and Immigration Services
- [Visa Wizard](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/visa-information-resources/wizard.html): Tool to help identify appropriate U.S. visa categories.
- [Visa Appointment Wait Times](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/visa-information-resources/wait-times.html): Estimated interview wait times by embassy or consulate.
- [Nonimmigrant Visas](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/tourism-visit.html): Visitor and temporary visa information for travel to the United States.
- [Immigrant Visas](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/immigrate.html): Permanent immigration visa process, categories, and required documentation.
- [Visa Denials](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/visa-information-resources/visa-denials.html): Explanations of common refusal grounds and next steps.
- [Fees for Visa Services](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/visa-information-resources/fees/fees-visa-services.html): Schedule of visa application and related service fees.

## News, Remarks, and Public Statements
- [Newsroom](https://www.state.gov/newsroom/): Central hub for press releases, remarks, briefings, and announcements.
- [Press Releases](https://www.state.gov/press-releases/): Official Department press releases and public announcements.
- [Remarks](https://www.state.gov/remarks/): Speeches and prepared remarks by Department officials.
- [Briefings](https://www.state.gov/briefings/): Press and background briefings on current foreign policy issues.
- [Fact Sheets](https://www.state.gov/fact-sheets/): Concise summaries of policies, initiatives, and bilateral relationships.
- [Secretary of State](https://www.state.gov/secretary-of-state/): News, travel, remarks, and materials related to the Secretary of State.

## Reports, Data, and Publications
- [Reports](https://www.state.gov/reports/): Department reports to Congress, annual reports, and mandated publications.
- [2023 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices](https://www.state.gov/reports/2023-country-reports-on-human-rights-practices/): Annual human rights reporting by country.
- [2024 Trafficking in Persons Report](https://www.state.gov/reports/2024-trafficking-in-persons-report/): Global assessment of government efforts to combat human trafficking.
- [2023 Report on International Religious Freedom](https://www.state.gov/reports/2023-report-on-international-religious-freedom/): Annual reporting on religious freedom conditions worldwide.
- [Investment Climate Statements](https://www.state.gov/reports/2024-investment-climate-statements/): Country-by-country assessments of investment environments and risks.
- [Foreign Relations of the United States](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments): Official historical documentary record of U.S. foreign policy.
- [Office of the Historian](https://history.state.gov/): Historical publications, archives, timelines, and educational resources.

## Treaties, Legal, and Official Records
- [Treaties and International Agreements](https://www.state.gov/treaties-and-international-agreements/): Information on treaty actions, agreements, and related legal materials.
- [Treaty Affairs](https://www.state.gov/bureaus-offices/under-secretary-for-political-affairs/office-of-the-legal-adviser/treaty-affairs/): Legal and procedural resources for treaties and international agreements.
- [Office of the Legal Adviser](https://www.state.gov/bureaus-offices/under-secretary-for-political-affairs/office-of-the-legal-adviser/): Legal guidance, offices, and subject-matter resources within the Department.
- [U.S. Treaty Actions](https://www.state.gov/treaties-and-international-agreements/u-s-treaty-actions/): Periodic updates on treaty signatures, ratifications, and other actions.
- [Treaties in Force](https://www.state.gov/treaties-and-international-agreements/treaties-in-force/): Annual publication listing treaties and international agreements in force.
- [Claims and International Agreements](https://www.state.gov/claims-and-international-agreements/): Materials related to claims settlement and international legal arrangements.

## Embassies, Consulates, and U.S. Missions
- [U.S. Embassies and Consulates](https://www.usembassy.gov/): Directory of U.S. embassies, consulates, and diplomatic missions worldwide.
- [Find an Embassy or Consulate](https://www.usembassy.gov/embassy-consulates/): Searchable list of embassy and consulate websites by country.
- [U.S. Mission to the United Nations](https://usun.usmission.gov/): U.S. diplomatic mission resources, statements, and policy materials at the UN.
- [U.S. Mission to NATO](https://nato.usmission.gov/): U.S. mission statements, speeches, and policy engagement with NATO.
- [EducationUSA](https://educationusa.state.gov/): Advising network for international students seeking U.S. higher education.
- [Exchange Programs](https://exchanges.state.gov/): International exchange programs, scholarships, and public diplomacy initiatives.

## Assistance, Business, and Public Programs
- [U.S. Citizen Services](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/international-travel/emergencies.html): Emergency and routine services for U.S. citizens abroad.
- [Intercountry Adoption](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/Intercountry-Adoption.html): Adoption process guidance, country information, and legal requirements.
- [International Religious Freedom](https://www.state.gov/international-religious-freedom/): Policy resources, reports, and office information on religious freedom.
- [Office to Monitor and Combat Trafficking in Persons](https://www.state.gov/office-to-monitor-and-combat-trafficking-in-persons/): Anti-trafficking policy, reports, grants, and program information.
- [Business Information Database System](https://www.state.gov/business-information-database-system-bids/): Commercial and business-related country information for U.S. firms.
- [Global Public Affairs](https://www.state.gov/bureaus-offices/under-secretary-for-public-diplomacy-and-public-affairs/bureau-of-global-public-affairs/): Public communication, media engagement, and digital outreach resources.

## Open Government and Administrative Resources
- [FOIA](https://foia.state.gov/): Freedom of Information Act requests, released records, and processing information.
- [Open Government](https://www.state.gov/open-government-at-state/): Transparency, accountability, and open government initiatives.
- [Inspector General](https://www.stateoig.gov/): Independent oversight, audits, inspections, and investigations.
- [Office of Inspector General Reports](https://www.stateoig.gov/reports): Published OIG audits, inspections, and evaluation reports.
- [Privacy](https://www.state.gov/privacy/): Privacy policy and information handling practices for Department websites.
- [No FEAR Act Data](https://www.state.gov/no-fear-act-data/): Required reporting on workplace discrimination and related complaints.
